status: completed AI independent image reading and discrepancy adjudication; unresolved details retained

scope.included: Selected large-print hexagram texts above the commentary rule; all continuation pages.

methodSummary: Fresh image-only contexts read every scoped page before receiving the initial transcription or OCR. The fixed 450 passages were then fully aligned by program. Discrepancies and explicitly selected high-risk items were referred back to the scans. Shared-model and shared-source bias remain possible.

aiUse.gemini: Gemini/Antigravity actual reported model gemini-3.8-flash-high for pp57–72.
aiUse.nativeAgents: Fresh Codex sub-agents; requested gpt-6.1-sol ultra for pp73–104 and121–210, requested gpt-6-astra ultra for pp105–120 and critical adjudication. Native execution telemetry did not independently expose exact model identity/usage.
aiUse.privateRecords: Detailed prompts, workers, processing code and full internal review logs are retained privately, not included in the public package.

passages.decision: Agreement after declared reader typography/romanization normalization; full image reading retained privately.
